en.headline: Motorcyclist dies after Pok Fu Lam crash; driver arrested
en.dek: Police said a 63-year-old rider died in hospital on Friday morning after a Thursday-night collision on Victoria Road.
body: A 63-year-old motorcyclist has died after a collision with a private car at the junction of Victoria Road and Mount Davis Path in Pok Fu Lam, police said. The crash was reported at about 10:30pm on Thursday near 168 Victoria Road.

Officers said the private car was travelling downhill from Mount Davis Path towards Victoria Road when it collided with a motorcycle heading towards Aberdeen. The rider was found unconscious with head injuries and was taken to Queen Mary Hospital, where he was certified dead at 9:46am on Friday.

The 50-year-old driver of the car, an off-duty auxiliary police officer, passed alcohol and drug tests, police said. He was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving causing death and has been released on bail. He is required to report back to police in early November. The case is being handled by the Special Investigation Team of Traffic, Hong Kong Island.
Police appealed for witnesses or anyone with information to contact investigators on 3660 6848. No further details of the cause of the collision have been released.

zh.headline: 薄扶林車禍鐵騎士不治 休班輔警涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方指63歲電單車司機周四晚在域多利道近摩星嶺徑相撞後，周五早上在瑪麗醫院證實死亡。
body: 薄扶林域多利道近摩星嶺徑交界周四晚發生交通意外，一名63歲電單車司機其後不治。警方表示，事發於周四約晚上10時30分，域多利道168號對開。
警方稱，一輛私家車沿摩星嶺徑下斜往域多利道行駛，與一輛往香港仔方向的電單車相撞。鐵騎士頭部受傷、昏迷，送往瑪麗醫院搶救，周五上午9時46分證實死亡。
涉事私家車的50歲司機為休班輔警。警方表示，他通過酒精呼氣及藥物測試，惟涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人死亡被捕，已獲准保釋候查，須於11月上旬向警方報到。案件由港島總區交通部特別調查隊跟進。
警方呼籲目擊意外或有資料的市民致電3660 6848與調查人員聯絡。意外原因仍在調查，警方未有進一步公布。
